paite: Huan Mosi in Israel suan tengteng akhawmkhawm a, akiang uah: "Hiaitę na hih ding ua TOUPA thupiakte ahi.
heading: Sabbath Tandan Ding

paite: Ni guk sung in nna sep zoh ahi dia, himahleh ani sagih ni noute a dia inn om ni ahi ding hi. TOUPA a dia Sabbath khawlna ahi. Sabbath ni a noute a dia inn om ni: Hiai ni nna sem peuhmah thah ding ahi.
Sabbath ni in na tenna peuh uah mei na chih ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
Israel suan kikhawmkhawm tengteng kiang ah Mosi in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N noute ahon thupiak hiaite ahi uh.
heading: Puanin Siangthou Thillat / (Eks 25.1-9)

paite: TOUPA a ding in na lak uah thilpiakte lakhawm un. Lungtang a utna nei kuapeuh in TOUPA a ding in thilpiakte: dangka-eng, dangka leh dal;
khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul;
belampa mul diahsan, ngalvang vun, singgi sing;
khawnvak a ding thau, thaunilh ding in gimlim; hal namtui ding;
onik suangte, siampu puanak leh awmtuam a siat ding suangmantamte hon tawikhawm uhen," achi hi.
"Na lak ua khutsiam tengteng na hong pai ding ua, TOUPA'N bawl ding chi a thu ahon piak tengteng abawl ding uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Vante / (Eks 39.32-43)

paite: Biakbuk, apuanin, akhuhna, asikkawi, asingpekte, asiktawnte, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte;
abawm leh achiangte, zahngaihna tutphah leh akhuhna puanzak;
dohkan leh achiangte, atui-um belsuan leh tanghou koihna;
khawnvak a ding in khawnvak koihna leng, avante, akhawnvakte, avakna thau;
gimlim maitam leh achiangte, nilh theih thau, gimlim leh biakbuk lutna kongkhak a dia puankhai,
halmang thillatna maitam, adal vutluah, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, tuikuang leh akhe;
ahuangsung puankhaite, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, huangsung kongkhak a dia puankhai;
biakbuk kilhna zumte, huangsung kilhna zumte leh akhaute;
nasepna puante, mun siangthou a nasepna dia siampu Aaron puan siangthoute, atapate puante bawl uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel suan kikhawm teng Mosi omna a pan apaita uhi.
heading: Mipite Tawi Thillatte

paite: Michih alungtang tohthoh a om peuhmah leh michih utna nei peuhmahte ahong pai ua, kihoupihna biakbuk lamna ding leh asung a nasepna ding leh puansilh siangthoute bawlna ding TOUPA ma ah thilpiak ahon tawi uhi.
Lungtang a utna nei pasalte leh numeite ahong pai ua, dangka-eng a kibawl thil tuamtuam: bilbah, nakbah, zungbuh, ohthoh leh butthoh kizepnate ahon tawi ua, TOUPA mai ah alan uhi.
Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul, belampa vun, ngalvang vun neite'n huaite ahon tawi uhi.
Thilpiak dia dangka leh dal neite'n TOUPA mai a thillat ding in ahon tawi uhi. Singgi sing nei teng in leng ahon tawi uhi.
Numei khutsiam teng in khut in khau akhek ua, akheksa uh ahon tawi ua, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih ahon tawi uhi.
Lungtang tohthoh numei tengteng in kel mul akhek uhi.
Vaihawm mite'n onik suangte, suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuam a siat dingte ahon tawi uhi;
gimnamtui hal ding singgah namtui leh det ding meivak leh nilh ding sathau a zat ding leh gimnamtui a hel ding sathau ahon tawi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak a, van bawl ding achih tengteng bawlna ding in Israel suante, numei leh pasalte'n amau ut thu in thilpiakte TOUPA mai ah ahon tawi uhi.
Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah, "En un, TOUPA'N Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi amin in asam a;
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Bawlmite Bezalel leh Aholiab / (Eks 31.1-11)

paite: Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna chiteng in amah adimsak hi.
Huai bel khutsiamtak a bawl dingte gelsiamna, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal thilbawlsiamna ahi a, bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna ahi.
bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna leh khutsiam thilbawl chiteng asiamna ahi.
Huan amah leh Dan nam a Ahisamak tapa Aholiab leng midangte sinsak siamna apia hi.
Amaute teng khuakthoh a thilbawl siamna chikim leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih gat zep siamna, gat siamna, ze tuamtuam gelh siamna nei ding in pilna apia hi," achi hi.
